tour.welcome.title: Welcome to SimFleet ✈️
tour.welcome.body: Let me show you the 5 main screens and the essential settings in under a minute. The tour switches screens for you as you advance. Press "Next" or use the ← → arrows. You can skip anytime.
tour.dashboard.title: 1 · Dashboard
tour.dashboard.body: Your home panel: total installed packages, disk space, top developers and the largest packages. Auto-updates when something changes in your Community folder.
tour.search.title: 2 · Search catalogs
tour.search.body: Search airports, aircraft, liveries and mods on SceneryAddons and Simplaza. Each card shows whether it's already installed and whether an update is available. The selector on the right switches catalogs.
tour.map.title: 3 · World map
tour.map.body: World view with all your installed airports as green dots. Click one to open its details. The amber badge marks the ones with an update available, and you can filter by GSX.
tour.addons.title: 4 · Your addons
tour.addons.body: Aircraft, liveries, instruments and mods you have installed. Filter by type, search by name, and open each one to reinstall or uninstall.
tour.flightbook.title: 5 · FlightBook (real flights)
tour.flightbook.body: Logbook of your MSFS flights, captured automatically through SimConnect. ICAOs, gates, landing FPM, fuel, passengers (via SimBrief OFP) and a flight evaluation. Click a flight to see its real route on the globe. While flying, the orange aircraft marks your current position.
tour.notifications.title: Notifications
tour.notifications.body: Updates available for your packages and the app show up here. The app checks at startup and on focus — no manual buttons.
tour.settings.title: Settings
tour.settings.body: Let's open Settings to see the essentials. Everything lives here: SimBrief, units, folders, backup, cloud, GSX profiles and more.
tour.settings_units.title: Settings · General & units
tour.settings_units.body: Here you pick language, dark/light theme, start with Windows and your SimBrief Pilot ID. Plus per-category units (weight, altitude, speed, distance, pressure, temperature) with quick imperial/metric presets.
tour.settings_folders.title: Settings · Folders
tour.settings_folders.body: The MOST important thing for everything to work: the path to your MSFS 2020 Community folder. Detect it or set it manually here. Without this, the app can't scan your addons.
tour.settings_cloud.title: Settings · Drive sync
tour.settings_cloud.body: Optional: back up and sync your FlightBook with Google Drive across PCs. It has a step-by-step guide and a button to test the connection.
tour.finish.title: Ready for takeoff! 🛫
tour.finish.body: That's it. You can replay this tour anytime from Settings → Tour. Happy flights!
